tato.cp: ind. from there; from that; thence; therefore; thereupon.
tato.p: (A) Just a complete sentence = Padapūraṇamatta. (B) A period which is without point beyond of. Tato(bya) [ta+to.(kaccaññaḥ 248. Rū. 260. Nīti, sutta. 493. Moga, 4. 95-8- See]. To-saddo tra-tha-saddā-dayo viya ekatthabahvatthesu vattanti. Jāta, ṭīkā, nidānaḥ, pe.(tatasa, tataḥ-saṃ)] (1) That is = Liṅgattha. (2) That are = Katvattha. (3) with that object or issue= Karaṇattha. (4) By that = Tatiyāvisesanattha. (5) Due to that object or issue = Hetvattha. (6) (A) From that = Nissakkattha. (B) Under that object or status = Nissakkattha. (C) more than that object or status = Nissakkattha. (7)That are = Sāmyattha. (8) In that object or issue= Bhummattha. (9) In that status = Niddhāraṇattha.
